item.title: What is policy? - King's College London
item.description: What is policy? While ‘policy’ can refer to a wide range of principles and procedures in different settings, in this context, a policy is a set of principles, implemented by government, detailing a plan or a course of action which is backed by law. Policies may be supported by associated legislation that sets out the law that must then be adopted and followed.
